_purpose: The INDEPENDENTLY AUTHORED set of production-only checks that must have run and passed before a candidate may be production-certified (Gate 4N-I20B, ruling item 3).
_why_this_exists: Gate 4N-I20A found that an artifact carrying `checks: []` certified successfully: the field was required to be PRESENT but never required to be non-empty, complete, or passing. A certification that proves nothing ran is not a certification.
_authority: Authored from what a production certification must actually establish. It is NOT derived from any artifact's own `checks` array, from the generator's current output, or from the candidate under validation — an artifact that could name its own required set would be certifying itself.

required_checks.purpose: the protected Tier-2 anchor was read from an explicit external path and matched a separately supplied expected digest
the protected resource inventory was read from an explicit external path and matched a separately supplied expected digest
no fixture marked NON_PRODUCTION_TEST_FIXTURE participated in the evidence chain
the certification names the exact candidate id and manifest digest under review
required_checks.source: candidate manifest supplied to the eligibility command

required_checks.purpose: HEAD, index tree, predicted commit tree and repository diff match the repository at eligibility time
every generated policy reproduced and passed its own validators
the emitted policy's writable role scope reconciles with the Terraform declarations
no live AWS identifier is present in any committable repository file
